purpose: HMRC Benefits in kind statistics (July 2026 release), the 2024-25 provisional rows the company cars stage draws fuel types and CO2 bands to and the national build reports the calibrated file against (PolicyEngine/uk-autumn-budget-dashboard-2026#316): Table 1 car and car fuel benefit recipients, taxable value, income tax and Class 1A NICs liabilities, with their total; Table 2A car benefit recipients by CO2 band; Table 2C car benefit recipients by fuel type; Tables 3A and 3B car and car fuel benefit recipients and taxable value by total income range; Table 4 car benefit recipients and taxable value by country and English region. They count individuals and pounds, rounded as HMRC publishes them; a cell HMRC marks instead of printing carries no fact. None is a calibration target: the stage's reviewed fence keeps them measured only. No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
